target_customer: Talent and people leaders at mid size tech and consumer companies such as Etsy, Chobani, Nuro, Harrys and Checkr
problem: HR data sits in separate systems, so people teams cannot easily see equity and workforce patterns. eqtble connects existing HR data and surfaces analytics and insights.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for people analytics

founders.name: Joseph Ifiegbu
founders.background_notes: Led HR technology at Snap and people analytics at WeWork; data scientist background.

founders.name: Gabe Horwitz
founders.background_notes: Built the HR analytics team at WeWork.

founders.name: Ethan Veres
founders.background_notes: Background not captured by the sources read.

competitors.name: Visier
competitors.what: Enterprise people analytics and workforce planning platform
competitors.traction_then: Reported as a unicorn after a 2021 round
competitors.funding_then: 125M round at a 1B valuation in June 2021

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs integrations with many HRIS and ATS systems, a data model, and analytics and visualization layers, which is standard but integration heavy work for a three founder team.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and customer data give mild lock in, but the analytics themselves were copyable and larger vendors already sold similar products.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Workday and others consolidated the space, and Paradox bought eqtble in February 2025 to add analytics to its recruiting AI.

market_need_then: Companies faced pressure around diversity, equity and pay fairness in 2020 and 2021, while HR data was scattered across tools. Peers like Visier were raising large rounds, showing spend on people analytics.

branding.domain_note: Used eqtble.com, a vowel dropped spelling of equitable.

identity.logo: Aggregator listing shows a simple lowercase e mark; not confirmed by a primary source

branding.community_and_virality: No evidence found of community, merch or brand press beyond funding and acquisition coverage.

brand_strength.rationale: Mission aligned but vowel dropped name with no sourced brand assets or community; press was about funding and the acquisition.

outcome_analysis: Founders came from WeWork and Snap people analytics, raised a 2.7M dollar seed led by Initialized in June 2021, and signed recognizable customers. The company was later acquired by Paradox in February 2025 for undisclosed terms, with the CEO continuing to lead the team inside Paradox. No sign of a larger follow on round was found, so the exit looks like a strategic tuck in rather than a scale outcome.
notes: The company website eqtble.com did not resolve from this environment, so it is treated as dead or blocked. The YC page links a December 3, 2024 press release while most outlets date the Paradox announcement to February 5, 2025; one aggregator says August 2025. The YC page also notes Workday later owned Paradox. Total raised aggregators show 2.8M to 2.9M, possibly including a small pre-seed that is not verified. The Visier source is dated after the batch start but describes a company that existed at founding.
